title: Agent Sentinel Configuration
description: Configuration for Agent Sentinel — real-time AI agent monitoring. This file controls which sentinels run, how they behave, and how observations are displayed.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor IntelliSense.

observation_window_hours.description: Number of hours to look back when showing observations in "All" mode. 0 means all time (no filter). Applies to status bar severity, Insights panel, and anywhere else that uses time-filtered observations.
observation_window_hours.markdownDescription:
Number of hours to look back when showing observations in **All** mode.

Applies to status bar severity, Insights panel, and anywhere else that uses time-filtered observations.

- `0` — All time (no filter)
- Positive value — look back that many hours
- Shorthand in UI: `30m`, `12h`, `3d`, `2w`, `1mo`

Minimum: `0` (all time). Default: `24` hours.

session_severity_mode.description: How to determine the severity icon for session groups in Observations. 'recent' shows the most recent observation's severity. 'highest' shows the highest severity across all observations in the session.
session_severity_mode.markdownDescription:
How to determine the severity icon for session groups in Observations.
- `recent` — most recent observation's severity
- `highest` — highest severity across all observations in the session

status_bar_severity_mode.description: How to compute the status bar severity indicator. 'recent' shows the most recent observation's severity within the window. 'highest' shows the highest severity across all observations within the window.
status_bar_severity_mode.markdownDescription:
How to compute the status bar severity indicator.
- `recent` — severity of the most recent observation within the window (default)
- `highest` — highest severity across all observations within the window

observations_view_mode.description: How to display observations in the Observations panel. 'grouped' groups observations by session (collapsed by default). 'flat' shows a live chronological feed.
observations_view_mode.markdownDescription:
How to display observations in the Observations panel.
- `grouped` — Group observations by session, collapsed by default (recommended)
- `flat` — Live chronological feed across all sessions

auto_start.description: Automatically start sentinel monitoring when a new agent session is detected.
auto_start.markdownDescription:
Automatically start sentinel monitoring when a new agent session is detected.

When `true`, sentinels will launch without requiring a manual `Sentinel: Start Monitoring` command.

defaults.description: Default values applied to all sentinels unless overridden per-sentinel.

model.description: Default Claude model used for sentinel evaluations.
model.markdownDescription:
Default Claude model used for sentinel evaluations.

Override per-sentinel with the `model` field in each sentinel entry.

visibility.description: Default visibility mode for sentinel observations.
visibility.markdownDescription:
Default visibility mode for sentinel observations.

- `auto` — Sentinel decides visibility based on observation severity
- `visible` — Always show observations to the user
- `transparent` — Observations are logged but not surfaced inline

execution.description: Whether sentinels run in parallel or sequentially.
execution.markdownDescription:
Whether sentinels run in parallel or sequentially.

- `parallel` — All sentinels evaluate concurrently (faster, recommended)
- `sequential` — Sentinels evaluate one at a time

display.description: Display and template configuration for sentinel output.

brand.description: Brand name shown in observation messages and the status bar.

observation.markdownDescription:
Template for formatting observation messages.

Available placeholders: `{{emoji}}`, `{{brand}}`, `{{domain}}`, `{{message}}`, `{{eval_id}}`

registration.description: Template for the registration message shown when monitoring starts.
registration.markdownDescription:
Template for the registration message shown when monitoring starts.

Available placeholders: `{{brand}}`, `{{version}}`

sentinels.description: List of sentinel configurations. Each sentinel monitors agent activity using a specific eval set.

name.description: Short identifier for the sentinel (e.g. "GEN", "SEC"). Used in observation output and state tracking.
name.markdownDescription:
Short unique identifier for the sentinel (e.g. `GEN`, `SEC`).

Used in observation output, state tracking, and log file names. **Required.**

enabled.description: Whether this sentinel is active. Disabled sentinels are skipped during evaluation.

model.description: Claude model to use for this sentinel. Overrides the default model.
model.markdownDescription:
Claude model to use for this sentinel.

Overrides `defaults.model` if set.

frequency.description: How often this sentinel evaluates the transcript.
frequency.markdownDescription:
How often this sentinel evaluates the transcript.

- `every-turn` — Evaluate after every agent turn
- `every-n-turns` — Evaluate every N turns (set N with `frequencyN`)

frequencyN.description: Number of turns between evaluations when frequency is "every-n-turns".
frequencyN.markdownDescription:
Number of turns between evaluations when `frequency` is `every-n-turns`.

Only used when `frequency` is set to `every-n-turns`.

visibility.description: Visibility mode for this sentinel's observations. Overrides the default.
visibility.markdownDescription:
Visibility mode for this sentinel's observations.

- `auto` — Sentinel decides based on severity
- `visible` — Always surface observations
- `transparent` — Log only, don't surface inline

Overrides `defaults.visibility` if set.

evalSet.description: Path to the eval YAML file, relative to the .volition/sentinel/ directory.
evalSet.markdownDescription:
Path to the eval YAML file, relative to the `.volition/sentinel/` directory.

Example: `evals/general.yaml`

evalVersion.description: Version of the eval set to use.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for this sentinel's evaluation call.
timeout.markdownDescription:
Timeout in seconds for this sentinel's evaluation call.

If the sentinel does not respond within this time, the evaluation is skipped and a timeout is recorded.

status_mode.description: Controls what status information this sentinel reports.

heartbeat_interval.description: Interval in seconds between heartbeat checks for this sentinel.
